title: Aether Documentation Frontmatter
description: Canonical schema for YAML frontmatter on Aether documentation pages. Validated by scripts/validate_frontmatter.py and (later) by apps/docs/lib/schema.ts.

title.description: Page title rendered in the docs site and used in nav.

slug.description: URL-safe slug; lowercase, hyphens, optional nested-path segments (e.g. sdks/web).

section.description: Top-level navigation section the page belongs to.

visibility.description: P = public (docs.aether.network), C = customer portal (auth-gated), I = internal (repo-only, never deployed).

audience.description: Personas the page is written for; at least one required.

status.description: Lifecycle status; renders as a badge.

since_version.description: Semver of the platform version this page first applies to.

last_synced_commit.description: Git SHA captured by sync_docs.py the last time source_files matched. Used by the drift detector.

commit.description: Resolvable source commit reviewed without an authored-content change.

reason.description: Short explanation of why the current page remains accurate.

items.description: Explicit review receipts for source commits that changed a declared source but not this page's authored content.

reviewed_source_commits.description: Auditable exceptions for reviewed source commits; each entry must resolve and touch a declared source.

source_files.description: Repo-relative source paths this doc derives from. Drift detector hashes them.

flags.description: Feature flag keys (e.g. IG_X402_LAYER) this page depends on. Validator can cross-check against settings.py.

prereqs.description: Slugs of pages the reader should have read first.

related.description: Slugs of related pages, rendered as a See Also section.

canonical_owner.description: CODEOWNERS-style team or email for the page's accuracy.

toc_depth.description: Maximum heading depth shown in the on-page table of contents.
